content: आलापः .²1 Talking, speaking to, speech, conversation; अये दक्षिणेन वृक्षवाटिकामालाप इव श्रूयते <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; प्रवसनालाप <ls>Amaru. 54</ls>; ललितालापे <ls>Śrut. 36</ls>. .²2 Narration, mention. .²3 The seven notes in music (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>सा, रि, ग, म, प, ध, नि</ns>). .²4 Statement of a question in an arithmetical or algebraical sum. .²5 A question. .{@-पा@} A particular मूर्च्छना or melody in music.
